findings.highlight: it's my responsibility to get to the bottom of this
findings.evidenceJa: 元を正せば俺の責任であることも棚に上げて
findings.explanation: Haruki admits that he shelves the fact that, at root, the situation is his responsibility while repeatedly pressing Koharu to change her mind. The translation instead defines his responsibility as getting to the bottom of the matter, replacing culpability with a duty to investigate or solve it.
findings.japanese:
そんなふうに俺は、
元を正せば俺の責任であることも棚に上げて、
何度も小春の翻意を促した。
findings.todokanai: I continue to ignore the fact that it's my responsibility to get to the bottom of this and insist on pressing Koharu to change her mind.

findings.highlight: She really has done a good job at maintaining her study ethic. Among Seisen's past exam questions, this is one of the more difficult ones…
findings.evidenceJa:

かなり難しい部類に入るはずなのに…
findings.explanation: The source discusses academic level or ability, while the English leans toward study habits or ethic.
